name: Barov Family Fortune
label: Quest
description: Barov Family Fortune: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Within the Scholomance lays the Barov family fortune. I, Alexi Barov, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house Barov. My brother, Weldon, is the other.
Weldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.
He now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Bow your head in my presence, traveler. I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, traveler. Now to secure my inheritance...
